citations.title: Ergonomics of the thermal environment — Assessment of heat stress using the WBGT (wet bulb globe temperature) index

variable_definitions.Tnw: Natural wet-bulb temperature (°C) with natural air movement and solar radiation on wet wick
variable_definitions.Tg: Black globe temperature (°C) measured at center of 150mm matte-black hollow sphere
variable_definitions.Ta: Dry-bulb ambient air temperature (°C) shielded from direct radiation

citations.author: Stull, Roland
citations.title: Wet-Bulb Temperature from Relative Humidity and Air Temperature
citations.journal: Journal of Applied Meteorology and Climatology

validity_domain.accuracy_statement: Validates with mean absolute error of 0.3°C across standard sea-level psychrometric tables, but exhibits ±0.5°C to ±1.0°C screening uncertainty relative to an actively aspirated natural wet-bulb with forced convection.

citations.authors: Liljegren, J. C., Carhart, R. A., Lawday, P., Tschopp, S., & Sharp, R.
citations.title: Modeling the Wet Bulb Globe Temperature Using Standard Meteorological Measurements
citations.journal: Journal of Occupational and Environmental Hygiene
citations.physics_basis: Energy balance equation equating radiative solar flux absorption with convective heat dissipation to calculate Tg and Tnw.

citations.organization: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), U.S. Department of Labor
citations.title: OSHA Technical Manual (OTM), Section III: Chapter 4 - Heat Stress

citations.mandate: Enforces mandatory midday work bans (12:30 to 15:00) during peak summer months and requires employer provision of shaded rest areas and hydration.

hardware_specifications.node_architecture: ESP32-WROOM-32 Wi-Fi/BLE IoT microcontroller running FreeRTOS

air_sensor.known_flaw: Capacitive polymer hygrometer suffers from condensation saturation drift above 99% RH, requiring software filtering for prolonged 99%+ readings.

globe_sensor.enclosure: Matte-black hollow copper globe (standard 150mm diameter or calibrated 40mm equivalent) exposed to ambient radiant flux.

methodological_disclosures.ground_truth_limitation: The Sentinel hardware derives ground-truth WBGT using Stull's (2011) psychrometric equation and black-globe thermometry rather than an aspirated natural wet-bulb wick. While practical and low-maintenance for construction sites, this introduces an inherent ±0.5°C to ±1.0°C screening uncertainty.
methodological_disclosures.spatial_transfer_limitation: A single sensor can only validate in-situ correction at its immediate physical worksite. Applying corrections to unsensored sites represents an unvalidated spatial extrapolation and is explicitly marked UNVALIDATED-SPATIALLY with widened conformal prediction bands.
methodological_disclosures.temporal_cross_validation: All model fitting is evaluated using strictly time-blocked cross-validation (contiguous non-overlapping multi-day blocks) to prevent temporal autocorrelation leakage between adjacent hours.
